decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass substrates under the publicly announced Advanced Connectivity Technology line are central to Plan Optik's strategic push into glass packaging, and slow uptake can be attributed to the still-emerging glass-core substrate market, so management will persist.

VLIS was only launched in 2024 with a dedicated page and is visibly positioned as a next-generation core technology, so sunk investment and public commitment make dropping it within a year very unlikely.
